name: entradas
description: Venta de entradas con asientos numerados (proyecto de Sistemas Distribuidos)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,api,worker,web --prefix-colors yellow.bold,blue.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold "npm run dev -w @entradas/shared" "npm run dev -w @entradas/api" "npm run dev -w @entradas/worker" "npm run dev -w @entradas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @entradas/shared && npm run build -w @entradas/api -w @entradas/worker -w @entradas/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @entradas/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
